desc.zh: 用两个堆维护中位数两侧的边界，逐次解释插入与再平衡。
desc.en: Maintain the two middle boundaries with two heaps as values arrive.

complexity: O(log n) per addNum; O(1) per findMedian; O(n) space

concepts.name: Two-heap split
concepts.description: Lower max-heap and upper min-heap expose the middle values.

concepts.name: Balance invariant
concepts.description: Every lower value is ≤ every upper value and sizes differ by at most one.
